notes.title: Merry Christmas
notes.content:
Merry Christmas! Our team "Daniel Projects" wishes you the Best! We have been working on "Jack Street" so far. So, next year we are going to show you more details about our game project. 
New experience in terms of dark adventure. We hope that the game will be released next year.
